items.title_orig: Want a new band to get into
items.article_text:
I mostly listen to grunge and prog metal, but I’ve tried a whole bunch of prog metal bands and didn’t really like a lot of them. My favorite bands are Pearl Jam, Alice In Chains, Stone Temple Pilots, TOOL, Mastodon, Gojira, Primus, and Queens of the Stone Age. But I also like Karnivool, Meshuggah, The Ocean, Opeth, Nirvana, and Soundgarden. And a little Screaming trees, RISHLOO, Siouxsie & the Banshees, Skin Yard, and Jamiroquai
 Sorry for naming so many, thought I should cover all the bands I like.
